name: Stripe gradient wordmark social card by stripe.com
description: A 1200×630 brand card built almost entirely from one gesture: a diagonal silk-like gradient sweep running from a cool lavender/periwinkle anchor in the lower-left through hot pink at mid-left into a saturated orange mass filling the upper right, with streaked anisotropic bands rather than a smooth CSS-style blend. The white extra-bold lowercase wordmark is the sole element, centered a touch above the vertical midpoint at roughly a third of the canvas width, so the entire focal hierarchy rests on colour field versus type contrast. There is no headline, tagline or framing device — the negative space and the diagonal motion do the communicating, which keeps the card legible at feed-thumbnail size.
